why_this_direction: The immutable original coordinate definition is compiled and the complete native loader, conditional function evaluator and fixed-original-mass integration have fixture tests. The next evidence is the actual original baseline and its measured cost, not another surrogate fixture or a weight update.
repeating_pattern_check: Earlier objectives measured residual states or token-conditioned support and defined successful zero by self inclusion. This run compares local functions at shared original inputs, excludes axis/recipient identities from the joint hull, retains all raw event pairs with original mass, and records numerical uncertainty. It does not treat an original-correct label as perfect computation.
hypothesis: Conditional first-order query functions on fixed original native-sized probes expose a recurring wrong-group departure from the original nonself joint agreement beyond successful leave-out departure. This is an experimental observable, not asserted full nonlinear equivalence.
what_went_wrong_before: Turn/log-gain was an input-dependent descriptor, memory transport changed attention geometry, and incomplete source support could dilute a scalar. All three are absent here: actual contexts stay put, probes/functions are fixed by original paths, and any missing acquisition or correspondence makes the whole result unavailable.
rule: All thirty original fitting acquisitions, fifteen successful axes, every question and answer event and all 105 merges. Native intercepts and original native inputs are immutable. Reconstruct actual-context keys/values with the declared Torch model and float16 cache; compare the local query affine functions on every original probe. One nonnegative mixture explains every probe/output coordinate; neither raw functions nor mapped current losses are pooled before measuring. Divide each original event mass among its distinct current events, then integrate with equal axes/recipients. Keep all local contributions and projection gap/rounding accounts.
prediction: A complete finite baseline is obtained with every original event/merge represented; wrong-member distance exceeds successful leave-out distance if this conditional-function observable isolates the recurring discrepancy. Actual elapsed seconds and memory are measured by this same run, not a separate timing ritual.
would_weaken_it: Nonfinite functions, unavailable source coverage or resource failure leaves the run incomplete, not zero. Similar or larger successful leave-out distances weaken defect isolation by this reference. A complete original baseline alone establishes no repair, native derivative equivalence, closure or transfer.

coordinates.derivation: Exactly its complete original axes, native-sized probe events, raw witnesses and hashes.

mass.derivation: Each recipient is averaged over all axes; each axis has 1/(its question+answer events * all merges); each raw current pair divides its original event share; probe weight is 1/(success count * mapped events of that success).
mass.scales_with: Original scope counts and raw correspondence multiplicity, never surviving support.

cache.derivation: Use the existing engine-cache reconstruction mode float16; straight-through cache rounding is part of the declared surrogate, not a captured native Jacobian.
cache.scales_with: The original engine cache representation and model architecture.

precision.derivation: Float32 native observations and query actions; float64 joint convex projection with source-defined numerical gap/bound. TF32 disabled; no agreement tolerance.
precision.scales_with: Represented dtypes, set size and function-coordinate dimension.

batching.derivation: One merge and original axis/domain at a time; each original function evaluated once where needed. Share one geometry per original event, group only equal complete dimensions, and never materialize repeated pair x witness x full-coordinate reference tensors. All original scope retained.
batching.scales_with: The full declared original inventory and correspondence shapes.

card.derivation: Use solver card 0 under gpu0.lock for all numerical functions in this run. Historical native observations were recorded on card 1 and retain that identity. There is no changed-weight or cross-card causal comparison.
card.scales_with: The local solver card assignment and historical acquisition provenance.

review: Eli mathematics review completed; records/retrospectives/2026-11-15-local-affine-candidate-astra.md. This declaration admits only the original-only numerical baseline, not a loop.
limits: No new engine acquisition, no model update, no no-fit access, no closure claim. Intercepts are native observations; conditional derivatives and cache reconstructions are the bound Torch surrogate.

revisions.reason: The first launch rejected a verified-own source solely because its original acquisition reached the generation limit. Preserve every original recorded event and all reference coordinates; report bounded generation scope separately, never as closure. Initial launch produced no numerical reading.

After the recorded projection allocation failure, reuse one full-coordinate function geometry per original event; a Gram factor proposes coefficients only, and every distance/optimality gap is evaluated in the original full vectors. All axes, probes, members and merges remain. Prior partials are retained under attempt-1; this is an explicit whole-reading restart, not partial closure.
